Let me provide you with a comprehensive overview of the issue-tracker skill. --- ## Issue-Tracker Skill - Complete Analysis ### 1. **SKILL.md - Complete Overview** #### **What the Skill Does** The issue-tracker skill is a **Plane issue tracker integration** that automates the entire development workflow: - Automatically detects issues from branch names - Tracks work status changes - Records change history and commits - Proposes sub-task divisions based on code changes - Creates detailed HTML comments with change summaries **Metadata:** - **Version:** 1.0.0 - **Category:** workflow - **Domain:** issue-tracking - **MCP Requirement:** plane #### **Activation Rules** | Trigger Type | Condition | Action | |---|---|---| | **Manual** | "이슈 연결", "이슈 추적", "plane 연동" etc. | Runs Phases 1-5 completely | | **Auto Suggest** | "작업 완료", "다 했어", "커밋할게", "PR 생성" | Triggers "Record on Plane?" → Phase 5 only if approved | | **Setup Init** | "plane 설정", "이슈 트래커 설정" | Runs Phase 1 only (creates `.plane-context.json`) | #### **5-Phase Workflow** **Phase 1: Context Loading** - Searches for `.plane-context.json` in project root - Extracts `project_identifier` - If missing: Auto-initializes by listing projects and asking user to select - Validates project via `mcp__plane__retrieve_project(project_id)` - Retrieves project metadata (labels, states, members) **Phase 2: Issue Discovery** - Runs `git branch --show-current` to get current branch - Parses issue identifier using regex: `/{PREFIX}-(\d+)/` (e.g., `PROJ-42`) - If found: Calls `mcp__plane__retrieve_work_item_by_identifier()` to auto-connect - If not found: Offers 4 options: 1. Direct number input 2. Keyword search via `mcp__plane__search_work_items()` 3. Create new issue via `mcp__plane__create_work_item()` 4. Proceed without issue connection **Phase 3: Work Tracking** - Checks current issue status - If not "In Progress": Asks user for status change approval - **Smart Categorization** - Analyzes 3 signals (priority order): 1. **Branch prefix** (highest priority): - `feature/`, `feat/` → Feature - `fix/`, `bugfix/`, `hotfix/` → Bug - `refactor/` → Refactor - `chore/`, `docs/` → Maintenance 2. **Commit message patterns** (secondary): - Keywords: "fix", "resolve", "close" → Bug - Keywords: "add", "implement" → Feature - Keywords: "refactor", "clean" → Refactor 3. **Diff patterns** (lowest priority): - High new file ratio → Feature - Mainly existing file modifications → Bug/Refactor - Runs `git diff --stat` to track change scope (files changed, insertions, deletions) **Phase 4: Scope Analysis & Sub-task Suggestion** - Runs `git diff --name-only` to collect changed files - Groups files by module based on directory patterns: - `api/`, `controller/`, `route/` → API module - `service/`, `usecase/`, `domain/` → Service module - `component/`, `page/`, `view/` → UI module - `test/`, `spec/`, `__tests__/` → Test module - `config/`, `infra/`, `deploy/` → Infrastructure module - `migration/`, `schema/` → Database module **Adaptive Depth Strategy:** - **Small changes** (≤5 files, 1-2 modules): No sub-task proposal - **Medium changes** (6-15 files, 2-3 modules): Optional sub-task proposal - **Large changes** (≥16 files, ≥4 modules): Aggressive sub-task proposals **Phase 5: Completion & History Writing** - Collects change summary data: - `git log --oneline` for commit history - `git diff --stat` for statistics - `git diff --name-only` for file list - Generates natural language summary - Creates HTML comment via `mcp__plane__create_work_item_comment()` using template - Optional: Records work time via `mcp__plane__create_work_log()` - Updates issue status to "Done" via `mcp__plane__update_work_item()` #### **HTML Comment Template** ```html

작업 이력

작업 유형: {{work_type}}

브랜치: {{branch_name}}

변경 요약

{{natural_language_summary}}

변경 통계

  • 변경 파일: {{files_changed}}개
  • 추가: +{{insertions}} / 삭제: -{{deletions}}

변경 파일

    {{#each changed_files}}
  • {{this}}
    • {{/each}}

커밋 이력

    {{#each commits}}
  • {{hash}} {{message}}
    • {{/each}}
``` #### **Tool Coordination** **Plane MCP Tools Used:** - `mcp__plane__list_projects` - Get workspace projects - `mcp__plane__retrieve_project` - Validate project - `mcp__plane__list_labels` - Get available labels - `mcp__plane__list_states` - Get available states - `mcp__plane__get_project_members` - Get team members - `mcp__plane__retrieve_work_item_by_identifier` - Fetch issue by ID - `mcp__plane__search_work_items` - Search issues by keyword - `mcp__plane__create_work_item` - Create new issue or sub-task - `mcp__plane__update_work_item` - Change issue status - `mcp__plane__create_work_item_comment` - Write HTML comments - `mcp__plane__create_work_log` - Record work time - `mcp__plane__create_work_item_relation` - Set dependencies between tasks - `mcp__plane__add_work_items_to_cycle` - Add to sprint/cycle - `mcp__plane__add_work_items_to_module` - Add to module **Git Commands:** - `git branch --show-current` - Get current branch - `git diff --stat` - Get change statistics - `git diff --name-only` - Get list of changed files - `git log --oneline` - Get commit history #### **Branch Name Parsing Rules** **Supported Patterns:** ``` {prefix}/{IDENTIFIER}-{number}-{description} {prefix}/{IDENTIFIER}-{number} {IDENTIFIER}-{number}-{description} {IDENTIFIER}-{number} ``` **Regex:** `/([A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-\d+)/` **Examples:** - `feature/PROJ-42-add-cart` → `PROJ-42` ✓ - `fix/PROJ-123-login-bug` → `PROJ-123` ✓ - `PROJ-7-quick-fix` → `PROJ-7` ✓ - `refactor/cleanup-utils` → Not found → Ask user #### **Boundaries** **Will Do:** - Auto-parse issue numbers from branch names - Connect/update issues, change status, write comments - Analyze change scope and propose sub-task splits - Auto-suggest history recording on completion - Auto-generate and manage `.plane-context.json` **Will NOT Do:** - Change issue status without user confirmation - Create sub-tasks without user approval - Delete issues/projects - Auto-modify code or commit - Change workspace settings --- ### 2. **plane-context.template.json - Template Structure** The template is **minimal and simple**: ```json { "project_identifier": "PROJ" } ``` **Structure Details:** - **Only required field:** `project_identifier` (e.g., "PROJ", "SHOP", "DEV") - This single identifier is used to: 1. Match against project list via `mcp__plane__list_projects` 2. Extract the `project_id` UUID 3. Parse branch names (e.g., `feature/PROJ-42-fix-bug`) 4. All other data (labels, states, members) is fetched at runtime via Plane MCP API **Initialization Workflow:** 1. File doesn't exist → calls `mcp__plane__list_projects` 2. Shows user list of available projects 3. User selects one → extracts its `identifier` 4. Auto-creates `.plane-context.json` with selected identifier 5. Git commits the file (safe to share since it only contains UUID/identifier) --- ### 3. **How the Skill References Templates and Workflow** **Template Usage:** - The `plane-context.template.json` is a **reference template** showing the minimal required structure - Each project creates its own `.plane-context.json` in the root directory - The template is NOT used at runtime; it's just documentation **Workflow Connection:** 1. **Phase 1** loads `.plane-context.json` → extracts `project_identifier` 2. **Phase 2** uses identifier to parse branch names (e.g., `PROJ-42`) 3. **Phase 3-5** use identifier to make API calls with proper context 4. HTML comment template (in SKILL.md) is used in **Phase 5** for change summary formatting --- ### 4. **Types of Issues and Comments Handled** **Issue Types Supported:** 1. **Feature** - New functionality (from `feature/` branch or "add", "implement" in commits) 2. **Bug** - Bug fixes (from `fix/`, `bugfix/`, `hotfix/` branches or "fix", "resolve" in commits) 3. **Refactor** - Code refactoring (from `refactor/` branch or "refactor", "clean" in commits) 4. **Maintenance** - Maintenance work (from `chore/`, `docs/` branches) 5. **Sub-tasks** - Auto-proposed splits from large changes (created as child issues) **Comment Types Handled:** 1. **Change Summary Comments** - HTML-formatted, includes: - Work type (Feature/Bug/Refactor) - Branch name - Natural language change summary - Change statistics (files, insertions, deletions) - List of changed files - Commit history with hashes and messages 2. **Status-related Comments** - Implied (when status changes, context is tracked) 3. **Sub-task Proposals** - Text-based suggestions with module breakdowns **Comment Templates:** - Uses Handlebars-like syntax (`{{variable}}`, `{{#each}}...{{/each}}`) - Supports HTML formatting for rich display in Plane UI - Adaptive detail based on change scope (simple, detailed, or full) --- ## Summary The **issue-tracker skill** is a sophisticated **Plane integration** that: 1. **Discovers issues** from branch names automatically 2. **Tracks work** through status transitions and change analysis 3. **Categorizes work** using intelligent multi-signal classification 4. **Proposes sub-tasks** based on change scope and module complexity 5. **Records history** with detailed HTML comments including change statistics 6. **Manages context** via minimal `.plane-context.json` (only project identifier) 7. **Works bidirectionally**: Either manual trigger or auto-suggest on completion keywords The skill is designed to keep development work synchronized with issue tracking without requiring manual intervention.
